comparisons.reason: Both read only 'argument' and are binary with null on missing, but the specs differ. Feature 0 counts acknowledging that other perspectives or reasonable positions exist, including 'I may be wrong' and 'I came here to see other sides'. Feature 1 requires acknowledging counterpoints, objections or opposing arguments to the OP's own view. Feature 1 also explicitly excludes marked edits that respond to commenters. Feature 0 does not say how edits are handled. Outputs can differ on rows with generic fallibility statements or with edits.
